english.title: Proprietor / driver of hackney carriage taking greater fare than authorised
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the

(A)_[proprietor]_
(B)_[driver]_

of a hackney carriage, namely **(..SPECIFY HACKNEY CARRIAGE..), took from **(..SPECIFY HIRER..), the hirer of the carriage the sum of **(..SPECIFY SUM TAKEN..) as a fare, being a greater sum than was authorised, namely **(..SPECIFY AUTHORISED SUM..), by a byelaw made under the

(C)_[Town Police Clauses Act 1847]_
(D)_[**(..SPECIFY SPECIAL LOCAL ACT..)]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 58 of the Town Police Clauses Act 1847.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine notexceeding level three on the standard scale. An order may be included for payment ofthe sum so overcharged, over and above the penalty and costs and shall bereturned to the party aggrieved

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
